label: Building
title: I automate most of my own work and build small tools with AI.
intro: Nothing here is a company. Each one started because something kept eating my time.

items.title: Max Control
items.text: An AI agent that works like a secretary: handles my scheduling, runs tasks for me automatically and tells me what to focus on.

items.title: Lumen
items.text: Takes the raw data from my Fitbit, reinterprets it in a design I actually want to look at, syncs it to the cloud and runs real analytics on it for training, recovery and general health.

items.title: Automations for recurring work
items.text: Interview write-ups, outreach lists, weekly reports.
